output.brief: Regular volunteers are leaving because of the two changes together, not the app alone. Both Dock Street and Westgate went on the app and lost their coordinators; they fell from about 112 to 55 and 105 to 49. Millbrook has the app but kept its coordinator, and it is steady (118 to 111). Quarry Lane lost its coordinator but never went live on the app, and it is also steady (86 to 80). On the app's basic tier, a regular only keeps a weekly slot if staff book it before the Thursday release. Staff bookings at those two sites fell from 74 a week to 3 a week after 1 May. 129 regulars lost their slot, and 88% of them are now inactive, against 11% of those who kept it. Callbacks mostly cite "nobody booked me". Background checks (121 of 123 lapsed volunteers were current) and Commonplate (2 of 61 callbacks) explain little. I'm fairly confident, with the main gap being that the site data is observational. Next: don't cancel the app or pause the checks. Assign someone to book regulars into their usual slots at Dock Street and Westgate, phone lapsed regulars, and review after 60 days. Don't purge the roster to improve the numbers. Check the Quarry Lane plan before its 6 October go-live.
